title: Short Term Configuration for Mobitopp Runs.
description: Configuration for a mobitopp run usin gshared attributes

scenarioName.description: The Scenario Name for the Simulation run.

seed.description: The core seed from which the agent RNG is constructed.

dataFolder.description: The repository where the Short Term Population input resides. This should be a folder where the standard input data for short term reside in a flat structure [activities, persons, households...]

fractionOfPopulation.description: The fraction of HOUSEHOLDS that should be simulated during the simulation.

visumNetwork.description: The path to the Visum network.

costMatrixConfigPath.description: The path to the yaml file containing the configuration for Cost Matrix Lookup

durationMatrixConfigPath.description: The path to the yaml file containing the configuration for Duration Matrix Lookup

distanceMatrixPath.description: The path to the matrix containing distances.
